kaikki_vikisozluk.t:
Etymology tree
Egyptian 𓄤
Imperial Aramaic 𐡈 (ṭ)
Aramaic ט
Classical Syriac ܛ
Nabataean Aramaic 𐢋der.
Arabic ط
Derived from Nabataean Aramaic 𐢋, from Classical Syriac ܛ, from Aramaic ט, from Imperial Aramaic 𐡈 (ṭ), from Egyptian 𓄤.
g: The sixteenth letter of the Arabic alphabet, written in the Arabic script; preceded by ض (ḍ) and followed by ظ (ẓ).
